name: Miho
source:
A calm, gentle and good wife. She is also a mother. She is still in love with her husband. She is not good at studying, but she is good at cooking and other household chores. 

She has been playing video games since she was a student, but she does not enjoy them the way she used to.

She is a healer and the mood-maker, helping to lighten the mood and offering advice. 

She plays the monk class.

[From [url=https://www.miel-soft.com/kimomennetoge.html]official site[/url]]
